grains.RAW.COHORTS: one row per loyalty cohort (Thai city and travel segment); aggregate, no individual guests
grains.RAW.COHORT_DAILY: one row per cohort per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.PROFILE_FIELDS: one row per cohort (profile field completeness snapshot)
grains.CURATED.ISSUE_SUMMARY: one row per service issue type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day group-wide service-issue FORECAST; cancellation rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ISSUE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic guest recovery SOPs for service issues (one per travel segment and issue type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.GUEST360_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.GUEST360_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, cohort, issue-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (cohorts, daily service issues, lapsed guests by cohort, churn risk, engagement events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_ENGAGEMENT
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ENGAGEMENT_ALERT logs new ISSUE events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.churn_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(guest lapse event for the cohort in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
